DOWNFALL-HERMIT_STRIKE.title: Strike
DOWNFALL-HERMIT_DEFEND.title: Defend
DOWNFALL-SNAPSHOT.title: Snapshot
DOWNFALL-SNAPSHOT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to unblocked damage dealt.
DOWNFALL-COVET.title: Covet
DOWNFALL-MEMENTO_CARD.title: Memento
DOWNFALL-BODY_ARMOR.title: Body Armor
DOWNFALL-BODY_ARMOR.description:
Discard 1 card.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If it was a non-Attack, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] again.
DOWNFALL-CALLED_SHOT.title: Called Shot
DOWNFALL-CALLED_SHOT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the last card played this turn triggered [gold]Dead On[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
DOWNFALL-COALESCENCE.title: Coalescence
DOWNFALL-COALESCENCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Retain[/gold] up to {CoalescencePower:diff()} cards this turn.
DOWNFALL-DIVE.title: Dive
DOWNFALL-FEINT.title: Feint
DOWNFALL-GLARE.title: Glare
DOWNFALL-HEADSHOT.title: Headshot
DOWNFALL-HEADSHOT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Deal double damage.
DOWNFALL-HIGH_CALIBER.title: High-Caliber
DOWNFALL-HIGH_CALIBER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Strike+[/gold] that deals {StrikeDamage:diff()} damage into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DOWNFALL-HOLE_UP.title: Hole Up
DOWNFALL-ITCHY_TRIGGER.title: Itchy Trigger
DOWNFALL-ITCHY_TRIGGER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Dead On[/gold]: Reduce the cost of a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] by {CostReduction:diff()} this turn.
DOWNFALL-LOW_PROFILE.title: Low Profile
DOWNFALL-MANIFEST.title: Manifest
DOWNFALL-MISFIRE.title: Misfire
DOWNFALL-MISFIRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Clumsy[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DOWNFALL-PISTOL_WHIP.title: Pistol Whip
DOWNFALL-QUICKDRAW.title: Quickdraw
DOWNFALL-QUICKDRAW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Next turn, draw 1 less card.
DOWNFALL-ROULETTE.title: Roulette
DOWNFALL-ROULETTE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Draw that many cards.
DOWNFALL-SPRAY_PRAY.title: Spray n' Pray
DOWNFALL-SPRAY_PRAY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
Shuffle a [gold]Doubt[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DOWNFALL-TRACKING_SHOT.title: Tracking Shots
DOWNFALL-VANTAGE.title: Vantage
DOWNFALL-WIDE_OPEN.title: Wide Open
